mentions.name: Rank
mentions.description: A programming language designed to be comfortably written on a phone, combining ideas from BASIC and APL: array operations, words instead of special symbols, and data-first function calls. The author is also considering building a dedicated handheld device with a physical QWERTY keyboard and multi-function keys like the ZX Spectrum had.
mentions.problem: Existing programming languages are not comfortable to write on a phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Rank - a language I could comfortably write on my phone. I'm even thinking about making a dedicated handheld with a physical QWERTY keyboard and multi-function keys like the ZX Spectrum had

https://rank.viewflow.io/

The language combines ideas from BASIC and APL: array operations, words instead of special symbols, and data-first function calls
